translations.web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
translations.bsb: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
translations.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
translations.asv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.
